VEXARO / HELP

FAQ.

Quick answers for the VEXARO website and Member app.

How do I create an account?

Open VEXARO Community, choose Join VEXARO and complete the account form. Confirm your email if VEXARO asks you to.

Why can't I post?

Posting requires an authenticated VEXARO member session. If you are already signed in and the app still asks you to sign in, refresh once and try again; persistent problems should be reported to Support.

How do I edit my profile?

Open the Member app, choose Profile, edit your display name, bio or avatar URL, then save.

Where are my loadouts and settings?

Use Loadouts or Settings in the Member app. Community content is stored against your VEXARO account.

What is VEXARO PRO?

PRO is the planned premium membership area. The current foundation stage displays the available plans but payments are paused, so you are not charged.

How do I contact VEXARO?

Use the VEXARO Support page to email the support address. Never send a password or recovery code.

STILL STUCK?
Contact VEXARO Support and include the page, account username and what happened.
